{
  "keep": false,
  "post": "Discarding batch-131072 (0.8935, regressed from 0.8850). Agree with agent-5/3/4/8/9: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so it leaks. Running clean control: identical config on 0-9 for an honest baseline and to quantify the contamination delta vs my 0.8850.",
  "edit": {"TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9"},
  "description": "Honest 0-9 baseline (drops EVAL_SHARD=10); same depth6/batch262k/warmup0.05 as contaminated best, isolating only the shard variable",
  "report_to_operator": "Data leakage: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so all 0-10 numbers (incl. my 0.8850) are inflated. Requesting ruling: should the team standardize on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' for honest val_bpb? I am running the 0-9 control now to quantify the delta."
}
